uploads.title: Swimming at Yankari Games Reserve
uploads.description: Me and my brother and my 'uncle' swimming at Yankari Games Reserve. My mom had been swimming with us, the water must not have been too deep because I only properly learnt how to swim four years ago. There were monkeys, me and my brother would point to them.  We drove there from Abuja, slept in Jos. We could do that then, explore the country by road. My mom said the roads are good, even now, it's a four hour drive. Now it's just the 'kidnapping matter.'
